about_the_game:
『HeroesSagaZero』 combines 2.5D battles with pixel art characters and elements of roguelite, loot-driven item collection, and class-based RPG systems.

Form your party freely and take on a variety of worlds in this single-player roguelite RPG.

In free-position battles, make full use of skills and strategic placement to wipe out your enemies!

Freely customizable equipment, stats, and skill system

Equipment comes with randomized options and special effects based on rarity. Collect set items and unique gear from each world and enhance them to suit your playstyle.

When leveling up, you can freely distribute your stats—boost HP for endurance, or focus on critical damage for swift eliminations. Build a character that’s truly your own.

Skills are unique to each class, and you can bring four into battle. Whether you prioritize offense, defense, or disruption, the tactical possibilities are endless.

[Jobs/Classes] Content may change in the final release as development is still in progress.

■ Gladiator: Specializes in high single-target damage. A frontline warrior who cuts through enemies using status effects like Bleed and Wound.

■ Priest: A master of healing and resurrection. Can also stand at the frontlines with holy attack spells, protecting allies as a shield of light.

■ Necromancer: Skilled in summoning, able to command defeated foes as minions. Alternatively, can build purely around dark magic, focusing entirely on offense without summons.

■ Mage: A master of fire, lightning, and ice. Each element brings effects such as Burn, Stun, Frostbite, and Freeze. You can specialize in one element or switch between all three for versatile tactics.

■ Assassin: A deadly killer who uses poison to finish enemies. Sacrifices endurance for overwhelming burst damage—survival depends on how you develop your build.

■ Knight: An unshakable guardian who protects allies. Adds shields or takes damage on their behalf, serving as the team’s bulwark.

■ Archer: Equipped with a wide array of ranged skills, capable of sniping enemy backlines with deadly precision from a safe distance.

■ Druid: A wielder of nature’s power, able to fight while fused with spirits, or summon them to aid and protect allies—two distinct playstyles to choose from.

More classes will be added in future updates!

Other Features

■ Roguelite: Explore procedurally generated worlds that change with every run. Each playthrough offers new challenges, where every choice carries both risk and reward.

■ Loot & Slash: Cut down enemies to obtain powerful set equipment and unique items. Since loot can be carried over, you can keep progressing without worrying about losses.

■ Strategy: Skills, stats, positioning, equipment, team composition—every decision impacts the outcome. Analyze enemy formations and refine your own unique tactics.

■ Game Modes: Experience story and lore in Story Mode, or face deadly battles against powerful foes in the high-difficulty Tower Mode. More modes will be added in future updates!

name: HeroesSagaZero
short_description: Pixel-art meets 2.5D battles in this strategy-driven, loot-focused roguelite RPG. Build your own team, master countless skill combinations, and collect gear with endless randomized options. No two strategies are ever the same—unleash your tactics and carve your path to infinite victory!
